description: The pie chart depicts the distribution of question answer types in the dataset, showing three slices (categories). The largest slice is labeled “Open-Answer (244)” and is colored green, with an internal percentage label of about 63.0%. The next slice is labeled “Multiple-Choice (127)” and is colored orange, with an internal percentage label of about 32.8%. The smallest slice is labeled “True-False (16)” and is colored blue, with an internal percentage label of about 4.1%. The category names with counts are placed outside the pie near their corresponding slices, and percentage values are printed inside each slice; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slices appear arranged roughly from largest to smallest around the circle.
